reason: Refactors a widely-used TagHelper base class (ContainsName→TryGetAttribute, added ShapeBuildingAsync hook) and touches Author-display rendering across multiple core admin views/modules, so any regression in attribute handling or shape caching could subtly break admin UI display across many content types, though the changes are additive and mechanically consistent.
